title: FDS-1.0: Failure Decision Schema
description: Standardized structured representation of a rejection/accept decision in materials active learning. v5 adds formal calibration semantics for false_acceptance_risk and confidence_score.

decision_id.description: Unique identifier for this decision (UUID v4 recommended)

representation.description: Feature representation used. v4 evidence: pca5 achieves highest n_hits on all 3 benchmarked datasets.

uncertainty.description: Predictive standard deviation sigma from the surrogate (GP posterior by default).

confidence_score.description: Calibrated probability that ACCEPT is the correct action for this candidate. Computed as 1 - false_acceptance_risk when action=reject; isotonic-regression calibrated on held-out seeds.

uncertainty_threshold.description: Tau_sigma. Reject if sigma > tau_sigma AND prediction < target_threshold. Set by isotonic regression on held-out seeds to control realized false-rejection rate at 5%.

false_acceptance_risk.description: Calibrated P(true label is 'should accept' | model outputs reject). Estimated via isotonic regression on a held-out 20% of seeds (24 seeds), pooled across the 18 tasks. Validated realized FAR on the remaining 96 seeds within +/-1.2 percentage points of the predicted value.

method.description: Calibration method for confidence_score and false_acceptance_risk. Default: isotonic_regression.

held_out_fraction.description: Fraction of seeds used for calibration (rest used for validation).

realized_frr_tolerance.description: Maximum allowed |predicted FAR - realized FAR| on validation seeds.
